raw_sections.summary:
Consultant – Digital Transformation
➢ Professional Summary –
Digital Transformation Consultant with 9+ years of experience in Process Excellence, Business Excellence, Lean Six Sigma, Business Process Reengineering, Automation, and Data Analytics. Proven expertise in partnering with business stakeholders to analyze, standardize, and optimize business processes, identify automation opportunities, redesign workflows, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that enhance operational efficiency, governance, and business performance. Strong background in Quality Management Systems (QMS), enterprise Business Excellence frameworks, and process governance, including organization-wide deployment and maturity assessments of business excellence frameworks.
raw_sections.experience:
➢ Work Experience – 9 years
WNS Global Services - Digital Transformation Manager May 2026 onwards
Drive digital transformation initiatives by partnering with client stakeholders and operations teams to analyze, redesign, standardize, and optimize end-to-end business processes aligned with operational and business objectives.
Drive Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement initiatives using DMAIC, process mapping, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and data- driven methodologies to identify process gaps, eliminate inefficiencies, and improve business performance.
Gather and translate business requirements into current-state and future-state (AS-IS / TO-BE,) process designs, workflow requirements, and solution specifications, collaborating with cross-functional teams through implementation and adoption.
Analyze process performance and operational metrics, developing KPIs, dashboards, and data-driven insights to identify bottlenecks, monitor improvement opportunities, and support informed decision-making.
Collaborate with global client stakeholders and cross-functional teams to facilitate process workshops, validate proposed solutions, manage dependencies, and support sustainable adoption of transformation initiatives.
Bristlecone India Limited (Mahindra Group) – Lead Business Excellence Nov 2021 – Apr 2026
Drove enterprise-wide Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Digital Transformation and Continuous Improvement initiatives across enabling functions including Procurement, HR, Finance, Workplace Solutions and Delivery Operations, driving end-to-end workflow transformation, standardization, operational efficiency, and process maturity enhancement.
Supported the enterprise-wide adoption and maturity improvement of Mahindra Group's Business Excellence framework, The Mahindra Way (TMW), aligned with Total Quality Management (TQM) principles. Worked across management and business processes to support Business Excellence deployment, process standardization, strategy deployment, governance, organizational maturity, and continuous improvement.
Led internal audits across business processes and functions to assess compliance with the Mahindra Group’s Business Excellence framework (TMW), and translating audit findings into Six Sigma driven process improvements, focused on defect reduction, waste elimination, cycle-time optimization, and risk mitigation through FMEA and CAPA.
Coordinated the annual Business Excellence (TMW) assessment conducted by the Mahindra Institute of Quality (MIQ), acting as the central point of coordination between MIQ and cross-functional process owners. Managed assessment planning, stakeholder coordination, documentation, evidence readiness, and follow-up on observations and improvement actions (CAPA).
Collaborated across stakeholders to represent continuous improvement initiatives and worked with Senior Directors, VPs, and SVPs on annual Business Excellence assessment presentations.
Served as the organizational point of contact for Group Common Policies & Practices (GCPP) assessments across Risk Management, Sustainability, CSR, and Safety, supporting governance, alignment, assessment readiness, compliance, and continuous improvement. • Owned and led the enterprise-wide Kaizen Program, driving a structured continuous improvement culture through Kaizen, Lean principles, process mapping, and Six Sigma DMAIC methodology. Governed the complete Kaizen lifecycle from idea registration, evaluation, implementation, validation, horizontal deployment, and recognition, ensuring sustainable business impact across functions. • Served as the Kaizen Subject Matter Expert (SME), coaching teams on problem identification, root cause analysis, solution development, and implementation best practices. Conducted organization-wide Kaizen awareness and capability-building sessions to improve participation and execution quality.
Developed standardized Kaizen evaluation criteria, review mechanisms, and governance practices to improve consistency, transparency, and effectiveness of Kaizen implementation across the organization.
Designed and deployed automated Power BI dashboards to monitor enterprise-wide Kaizen performance, implementation status, approvals, benefit realization, horizontal deployment, and recognition metrics, enabling leadership governance, transparency, and data- driven decision-making.
Partnered with process owners to identify transformation opportunities, redesign operating models, streamline workflows, and implement continuous improvement initiatives aligned with organizational strategic objectives and enterprise governance frameworks.
• Leveraged Python and SQL to develop automation solutions, optimize data processing and reporting workflows, and support Lean Six
Sigma and digital transformation initiatives through data-driven insights and process automation.
Conducted end-to-end process assessments, process mapping, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, and CAPA exercises to identify operational gaps, redesign workflows, mitigate risks, and implement scalable process improvement solutions across business functions. • Skilled in process mapping and process modelling using BPMN and Visio, supporting AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, workflow redesign, and business process improvement.
Designed and institutionalized a Daily Work Management & Standardization (DWMS) maturity assessment framework for delivery projects, enabling standardized governance, operational discipline, process adherence, and delivery consistency across project teams. Developed Power BI dashboards for leadership reviews, providing visibility into maturity trends, compliance tracking, KPI performance, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (SSBB) – expertise in Lean Six Sigma methodology, advanced statistical tools (Minitab), and process transformation.
Implemented small-scale process automations using Python, VBA, Power Automate, Power Apps to streamline manual workflows, improve reporting efficiency, reduce turnaround time, streamlining manual reporting workflows and supporting RPA-led digital transformation initiatives.
Applied analytics and automation capabilities using Python, SQL, Power BI, and Minitab to build automated reporting solutions, analyze trends, improve process visibility, and support data-driven business transformation initiatives.
Designed and institutionalized an FMEA framework with standardized SOPs, enabling proactive risk identification and preventive controls across the organization.
Acted as transformation catalyst by training associates in Quality, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, Agile, and Lean practices, embedding a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.
Trained 1000+ employees every fiscal year on Lean, Kaizen, 7 QC Tools, and Six Sigma methodology; helped identify Six Sigma project opportunities and mentored Yellow Belt, Green Belt, and Black Belt projects.
Developed training content for Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and 7 QC Tools to support organization-wide capability building and continuous improvement adoption.
Owned the continuous improvement lifecycle from project identification and scoping through mentoring and closure, including 4+ Black Belt projects at Bristlecone, 2 Yellow Belt projects at WNS, 2+ Green Belt projects at Amazon, and 5+ Yellow Belt and 3+ Green Belt projects across other organisations.
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) – trained in Agile philosophy and Scrum framework, with working knowledge of SDLC and program/project management practices.
Amazon Development Centre (India) - Quality Analyst July 2020 to Nov 2021
Conducted comprehensive risk assessments and quality audits, identifying systemic gaps, non-conformities, and driving Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA) aligned with Amazon’s Defect Management standards.
Redesigned and implemented Quality Management and Defect Management frameworks for Compliance Operations across Singapore and Australia marketplaces, strengthening process efficiency and regulatory compliance.
Developed and monitored KPIs, Quality Metrics, and Weekly Business Review (WBR) reports, enabling leadership to take data-driven decisions for defect reduction, process optimization, and seller experience improvement.
Performed advanced statistical analysis on process performance data to uncover trends, streamline workflows, and improve compliance accuracy.
Served as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Quality Operations, leading compliance reviews, query resolution forums, and cross- functional collaboration with global stakeholders.
Led continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality defects, identifying process improvement opportunities, conducting root cause analysis, and partnering with operations teams to implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), improving process quality and operational performance.
Facilitated quality review discussions with stakeholders, standardized best practices across teams, and drove process optimization through data analysis, SOP enhancements, and performance monitoring.
Contributed as a team member in an enterprise Ideathon initiative, supporting the end-to-end process improvement idea submission, evaluation, and selection. Assisted in reviewing employee-submitted ideas, identifying high-impact opportunities, and facilitating the selection of feasible ideas for implementation.
Standardized process documentation and onboarding material, ensuring effective knowledge transfer and consistent training for new hires.
Championed continuous improvement and Lean Six Sigma practices, leading initiatives that improved operational efficiency, compliance accuracy, and seller trust.
Mahindra Accelo, Pune - Business Excellence Associate Nov 2018 – Nov 2019
Overseeing Operational Excellence/Process Excellence activities across all plants, driving Business Excellence methodologies, and ensuring compliance with Mahindra Group’s Business Excellence model The Mahindra Way (TMW) to achieve world-class business results.
Planning and executing annual TMW assessments, facilitating Manufacturing Excellence practices through Lean, Continuous Improvement, and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Methodologies.
Acted as the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Coordinator, managing TPM audits conducted by the Japanese Institute of Plant Maintenance (JIPM).
Responsible for Integrated Management System activities, including ISO audits for QMS (ISO 9001:2015), EMS (ISO 14001:2015), and OHSMS (ISO 45001:2018) standards, and document control of departmental documents policies.
Developed and maintained ISO documentation, including process control documents such as SOPs, IBPs, OCPs, work standards, work instructions, and safety measures. Ensured documentation accuracy through regular review and updates.
Conducted Internal audits for QMS and actively participated in various Customer Audits/Third-party audits, serving as the key point of contact for audits. Engaged in Management reviews and process/system audits, ensuring compliance with standards and regulations. • Coordinated the enterprise Kaizen program by governing the complete Kaizen lifecycle, tracking implementation progress, validating closure status, and publishing management dashboards and reports for senior leadership. Facilitated cross-functional engagement to improve Kaizen participation, implementation discipline, and continuous improvement governance across business units.
Six Sigma Green Belt project execution; Handling Six Sigma Project reporting. • Prepared presentations for VP and Plant Head, showcasing complex information in a clear and concise manner. Also, oversaw Safety Activities ensuring compliance with EHS and OHSMS standards.
Delivered training on Quality Management System, Kaizen, and related topics, ensuring that employees were equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge for process improvement. Also, regularly updated training material to reflect the latest industry practices and standards
Wipro Enterprise Pvt. Ltd. Amalner- Graduate Trainee July 2017 to July 2018
Demonstrated proficiency in performing maintenance activities in soap manufacturing, fatty acid, and glycerin plants, ensuring smooth operations and minimal downtime.
Actively monitored and improved Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) through focused Kaizen initiatives, enhancing equipment reliability and efficiency.
Conducted hands-on field investigations on machine problems, applying analytical skills to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
Collaborated with engineering personnel to resolve complex issues in system operation and maintenance, demonstrating strong problem- solving abilities.
Planned and coordinated manufacturing projects, ensuring timely execution and adherence to project schedules and budgets. • Conducted various analyses, including Look-Listen-Feel Analysis and Why-Why Analysis in Preventive Maintenance, to identify and address underlying issues proactively.
• Assisted in managing staffing plans and work schedules, gaining valuable experience in supervisory activities.
• Participated in and faced ISO Audits, ensuring compliance with standards and maintaining accurate documentation of maintenance
activities.
Demonstrated a consistent record of high-performance standards, emphasizing attention to schedules, deadlines, budgets, and quality work.
Contributed to cost reduction efforts by proactively participating in the procurement of items/materials required by the maintenance department.
Identified loopholes in the existing Perfume Dosing System and contributed to the design and installation of a new system, incorporating learnings from past issues.
Managed a project involving the storage of mixed fatty acids, including the shifting and installation of a 50kl tank, and upgraded the existing design for pumping and piping applications.
Served as a core team member for Six Sigma Green Belt projects focused on reducing downtime during changeover activities, rejection reduction; demonstrating strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Led a project to overhaul a stamping machine IMSA, ensuring its optimal performance and reliability.
Royal Motors - Operations Associate Jul 2014 - Feb 2015
